specs.name: 立体书插图_结构与留白修正
specs.file: 四钱灵_纸艺立体书插图_结构留白_v02_20261121.png
specs.prompt:
EDIT this exact four-animal Chinese papercraft game illustration. Preserve the FOUR character identities, clothing colors, expressive faces, cream cutout edges, their general positions and the wide OPEN POP-UP BOOK. The user says the ARCHITECTURAL STRUCTURE IS WRONG and BACKGROUND TOO BUSY. Correct these two issues decisively while retaining the sunny hand-painted gouache paper-theatre style.
BACKGROUND: remove the giant golden sun disk, remove ALL oversized ginkgo-leaf clusters and most clouds, remove the layered continuous mountain wall. Use luminous near-plain warm cream negative space occupying about 45 percent of entire image, with ONLY one faint low distant jade mountain silhouette in the far lower background and ONE restrained small ginkgo branch at far left edge, no leaf directly behind each character. Very few background shapes. No floral fill, no confetti, no halo, no pattern texture. Don't replace decorations with another busy ornament.
ARCHITECTURE: replace the current incoherent interlocking floating roof fragments with ONE compact, structurally coherent Song-inspired simple three-bay timber workshop centered in the book, below the two upper characters. ONE clear rectangular footprint. ONE continuous simple gabled roof with two connected slopes and a SINGLE straight horizontal ridge, grey-blue tiles indicated by widely spaced tidy lines. Roof loads rest on a continuous front beam, clearly seated on FOUR upright timber posts at front; matching rear posts explain building depth. Left bay has a simple lattice wall, middle bay open, right bay open with the printing bench. Visible small sidewall at right recedes consistently to SAME vanishing point as roof and floor. Posts end on the book's ground plane / a thin paper ground patch; no floating beam ends, no arbitrary extra roofs, no beams passing through animals. Mildly upturned eaves only, no ornate dragon ridges. Structural solidity must be obvious even as a flat paper pop-up.
Show the drying rack as a SEPARATE simple low freestanding frame in front-left of building with TWO blank hanging sheets, with two posts on the floor; NOT a roof supporting another roof. Print table clearly four legs with front stretcher, thin printing block on flat tabletop, behind panda. Otter's papermaking tub remains foreground left. The central continuous paper strip still goes from monkey's paws toward table, but cleanly arcs through OPEN SPACE ABOVE/BESIDE building and never slices through roof or beam.
Four characters remain exact: otter bottom-left indigo, monkey top-left jade/red scarf, panda bottom-right red/teal, red panda top-right green with fan and ring tail. Upper monkey/red panda must stand on visible modest folded-paper risers connected down to the open book, NOT on unsupported loose roofs. Avoid duplicating characters or props. If needed make the central workshop slightly smaller so it is fully readable between the animals. Keep head/body proportions, expressions, tools and costumes unchanged.
Clean medium-width hand ink contours, large flat painted shapes, only soft paper cast shadows and light folds, no high frequency texture/no dirty grain/no plastic3D. Same warm ivory, gold, jade, vermilion, slate palette. No text, people, real hands, logos or UI. Finished 16:9 illustration with relaxed breathing space and correct connected architecture.

specs.name: 选关_疏密层次优化
specs.prompt:
Refine reference1 level selection UI after user says it is TOO SIMPLE AND MONOTONOUS. Keep clean smooth hand-painted paper style, correct coherent architectural perspective, warm printing desk/open album, and route order COPPER COINS → BLANK PAPER → JIAOZI → exchange-house. Reference2 guides STAGGERED interesting node sizes and organic world-map composition, not its characters/currency HUD. Find a deliberate middle ground: meaningful MEDIUM-SCALE environment forms and dimensional landmarks, with quiet negative space; do NOT reintroduce high-frequency texture/grain/microdecorations, dense mountain hatching or tiny villages everywhere.
The current four equally sized tokens on giant identical beige platforms and huge orange arrows look like a basic flowchart. REDESIGN their scale/placement asymmetrically like an illustrated explorable paper-map: 01 coins is smallest lower-left near riverbank, 02 papermaking workshop is medium upper-left/center, 03 upright Jiaozi banknote+thin woodblock is tall/slim upper-right, 04 exchange house is largest lower-right. Keep ALL FOUR visible with each distinct silhouette. No uniform 2x2 grid, no identical giant flat pedestals: small folded paper bases with precise contact shadows, level labels next to tokens. Correct order readable 01→02→03→04 along one gently winding PRINTED path with a few tiny waymarks, remove thick diagram arrows.
Fill the flat MAP with a deliberate natural composition in 3 broad areas: a jade winding river flowing from upper center past left-center to bottom left; a warm cream curving bank/road crossing it via ONE small FLAT-PRINTED stone arch bridge; grouped olive/teal rolling hills at upper back and lower front corners. Add only TWO groups of low stylized ginkgo/bamboo silhouettes, one small flat printed cluster of TWO distant grey-roof houses, and short clear bank contour/waterflow lines. These are calm bold shapes printed ON the sheet, not raised terrain. Let about35-40% of map remain open cream breathing space. Avoid blank geometry-only look, but also avoid dense landscapes. No busy wave patterns, foliage speckles, tile grids, particles, ornamental clutter.
Make level buildings more authored with meaningful structural detail: 02 has simple correct grey roof, continuous red beam supported by posts, front drying rail with TWO blank sheets and a small aligned white paper stack; 04 has coherent single main roof, side wall depth consistent with main camera, grey tile bands widely spaced, simple lattice window, doorway, small gold hanging shop plaque and chest. Every roof ridge/eave/beam/post/footprint uses the SAME elevated view as book, no warped beams or floating roofs. Grey slate, terracotta framing, muted amber highlights. Use modest two-tone shading and thin cream cut edges rather than heavy extruded toy frames. Coins have square holes, Jiaozi has ink border and red seal, no humans.
Labels exactly “01 铜钱”, “02 纸张”, “03 交子”, “04”. EXACTLY3 stars below EACH with gold-filled counts3/2/1/0 respectively; subtle simple paper strips and thin outlines, same typeface and size. Keep “历史星级” legend, “选择关卡” upperleft with back arrow, “选择搭档” lower right small red paper tab. Existing desk tools stay subtle; no new resources UI. Use unified palette warm ivory #F4E6C8, ink #34251D, dark walnut #4F3021, vermilion #B5452C, jade #2D7770, gold #D6A545. Flat elegant pigment textures only, crisp silhouettes, soft controlled shadows, same STYLE as ref1. Richness comes from designed shapes, space, proportion and meaningful detail, not noise. 16:9 full finished screen.
